input: Find small art studios, dance studios, music teachers and gyms that run a few weeks of summer camp for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Johnson City TN dance studio summer camps 2025 2026
Madison Yancey Mitchell dance art studio summer camp 2025 2026
"Johnson City" summer camps music lessons academy

candidates.name: Dance and Karate Express
candidates.note: Themed children's summer camps combining dance, karate and activities.

candidates.name: Madison County Arts Council
candidates.note: First Stage Youth Theatre runs a weeklong summer camp exploring theatre and performance.

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: Weeklong children's art and craft camps and teen workshops.

candidates.name: MOMAC Studio
candidates.note: Four weeks of summer art camps and a three-day writing camp offered in 2026.

candidates.name: Into the Fire
candidates.note: 2026 themed art camps run Tuesday–Friday, 9–11:30 a.m., with a Friday art show.

candidates.name: Johnson City Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 Princess Ballerina Camp includes crafts, games and dance-related activities.

candidates.name: Studio Dance
candidates.note: Six-week summer dance program for ages 3–18 offered June 8–July 16, 2026.

candidates.name: Shellshead Ballet Conservatory
candidates.note: Audition-based summer ballet intensive for ages 12+, including pointe and contemporary dance.

candidates.name: Appalachian Stars Gymnastics
candidates.note: Summer gymnastics camps combine training, recreational activities, crafts and field trips.
